exact_tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original square head-and-shoulders portrait SOURCE CANDIDATE for the project's roster hero Tomoe Gozen, exact key tomoe-gozen.
Primary request: Create ONE original bust portrait preserving the identity, palette and miniature craftsmanship of the own-project current concept just opened in this conversation, art/imagegen/concept-tomoe-gozen-codex/design/tomoe-gozen-front.png. Use that image as character reference, not as a source to crop. Preserve her specific composed young adult Japanese woman warrior face, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, straight dark brows, black hair pulled into a high ponytail with parted loose forelocks, broad plain ivory-white cloth headband and two loose white cloth ties extending to viewer right.
Scene/backdrop: plain empty charcoal gray.
Subject: Tomoe Gozen, almost frontal with a very slight natural turn, looking at the viewer with a calm resolute expression; both eyes fully readable and unobstructed. Her complete high ponytail crown and white headband are visible. Long sculpted black locks descend behind her shoulders. Wear the same red lacquered o-yoroi upper armor, navy blue lacing and ties, gold edging and round gold fastening medallions, charcoal patterned undersleeves and ivory collar seen in the project concept. No helmet or invented crown. Omit the long naginata from this head-and-shoulders composition so the face is clear.
Style/medium: original premium hand-painted collectible tabletop MINIATURE bust art with coherent sculpted facial planes, sculpted black hair strands, fine restrained brush texture, lacquered lamellar plates, cloth cords and controlled gold highlights. Keep it a crafted game figure illustration/render, no human photographic avatar, actor likeness or commercial scan.
Composition/framing: square canvas with deliberately pulled-back head-and-shoulders plus upper-chest composition. Preserve wide circular-crop margins: entire hairstyle including top ponytail knot, headband and both tie ends must be visible with generous charcoal air. Keep the highest hair point at least 15 percent below the upper edge; complete head and ponytail crown within the central 48 percent of canvas width, white tie ends inside the central 70 percent. Center eyes horizontally around 44 percent of image height. The head itself occupies about 38 percent of canvas height. Shoulders and upper chest sit in the lower half. Use the entire square for a future centered circle of diameter 100 percent of square side (full100), zero zoom. Head, hair crown, ears and headband ties should fit comfortably inside that imaginary circle; lower shoulders can enter bottom corners. No close-up or oversized face, no hands, pedestal, full body, weapon or separate prop.
Lighting/mood: soft warm-neutral studio key and gentle fill, clear dark eyes, readable ivory headband against black sculpted hair, restrained highlights and strong material separation.
Color palette: lacquer red #9B2E26, cord blue #2F4F8F, hair black #1A1719 and trim gold #D4AE45, natural warm skin and plain ivory-white headband. Preserve the project's muted miniature palette.
Constraints: one original character only. Whole head, hairstyle and headband visible; no top/side clipping or cropped tie ends. No lettering, symbols on headband, numbers, logos, watermark, frame, badge, circle border, circular mask, cards, UI layouts, collage, scenery, smoke, special effects or photographic portrait treatment.

reference_use: Own current front design opened with view_image before the call and used as identity/style/palette context. Brand-new generation: no referenced_image_paths or num_last_images_to_include supplied. No commercial scans or avatar images opened.

known_issues.note: На поясе есть дополнительный меч в ножнах: verification.json#core_limitations отмечает нарушение CORE «extra weapons». Он не скрывает нагинату и не меняет узнаваемость TomoeGozen; отдельного вето для меча в ножнах предоставленная рубрика 1a не задаёт.
Двухъярусная подставка шире ориентира: verification.json оценивает отношение диаметра к высоте фигуры без оружия примерно в 0,65 вместо 0,55. Фигура и подставка целиком видимы.

Видна узкая верхняя поверхность подставки, поэтому строгая ортографичность не достигнута; это также отмечено в verification.json. На 1a согласованность видов не оценивалась, фиксированное C сохранено.
Синие шнуры несколько серее и менее насыщенны, чем заданный cord blue #2F4F8F.
